title: Georgia Nolan Smith 2023 Panini Prestige RC No.368 Philadelphia Eagles
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prestige sports trading card features Nolan Smith, a rookie player from the Philadelphia Eagles. The card is part of the base set and has a parallel/variety design, making it a great addition to any collection. 

The card number is 368 and it is a National Football League (NFL) league product. It is not autographed and is manufactured by Panini. This card is perfect for any fan of the sport, especially those who collect trading cards. Get your hands on this amazing card and add it to your collection today!
